name: no-v1-ingress-topology

base_results.finding: validator-1 ingress underdelivered while validators 2-4 reached target
validator-1 writer overprovision did not restore p1 delivery

purpose: Recover a stable green live benchmark surface by excluding validator-1 as an ingress/loadgen source while keeping validator-1 in the four-validator consensus set and correctness checks.

harness_change.description: Optional space-separated validator names from hosts.txt to use as ingress/loadgen sources. Consensus/state checks still use the full hosts.txt via live_network_status and explicit state-root checks.

planned_benchmark.command: LOADTEST_OUTPUT_DIR=/tmp/and-live-247-no-v1-ingress-100k-60s LOADTEST_VALIDATOR_NAMES='validator-2 validator-3 validator-4' LOADTEST_DRAIN_SECS=30 LOADTEST_BATCH_SIZE=8 LOADTEST_PIPELINE_DEPTH=1 bash chain/scripts/loadtest_live_network_multi_ingress.sh /tmp/and-live-testnet 32 100000 60

result.decision: Binned. Excluding validator-1 as ingress avoids the slow host but raises per-endpoint target to about 11.1k RPS, which validators 2-4 did not sustain under p1. Throughput fell below item 245.

notes: This does not remove validator-1 from consensus; it only stops using validator-1 as a loadgen/ingress source.
If this recovers green TPS, the live benchmark topology should be treated as role-aware: validator-1 can remain validator-only while other hosts carry ingress.
